cases.meaning: Original residual width, conditional on175 NET clear after leaf/ribs.

normal.proof: Earlier bed and later flow bound every path interval. For narrower width b in[lo,hi], normal depth is bounded by b=hi because the sum of the two convex Manning width-conveyances decreases toward equal widths. The widest lane is at most B-lo. Hydraulic radius and K4 velocity increase with both width and depth. These separate upper bounds cover every width split continuously.

blocked.proof: For a common end-to-end head, lane discharge is A*sqrt(head/(n^2*L/R^(4/3)+K/(2g))). Its conductance is convex in lane width when the local/friction coefficient ratio is below5. The maximum ratio over widths0..B is reported and is below5, so equal widths minimise total conductance. This proves the conditional common-level longitudinal bound, not entry or cross-transfer.
